segments.text:
GRaunt O Lord God, that ſeing wee do liue now amongeſt ſo many enemies, and the Deuill neuer ceaſeth to ſtirre agaynſt vs new troubles, ſo that all the world is enraged agaynſt thoſe that tranſforme themſelues
from the vanities of this world that they may the better ſerue thee: Graunt we beſeech thee, that we may perceaue both the deuill himſelfe and all his wicked powers, to be ſo brideled and ſubiect vnto thee, that thou canſt turne them and direct their hartes which way thou thinkeſt beſt, that we learning by experience that we ſhall alway be ſafe and ſure vnder thy protection, as thou haſt promiſed vs, may continually go forward in our vocation, deſpiſing the pleaſures, and not fearing any terrors, whiles at the length we may come to that bleſſed reſt which is laid vp for vs in the heauens through Ieſus Chriſt our Lord.
